description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'LoraUtils' that provides common helper methods for handling LoRa gateway configurations, URL normalization, hex/Base64 conversions, and validation checks within the LoRa adapter component of the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: LoraUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for LoRa network configuration validation, URL normalization, and data encoding conversions.

methods.name: isValidLoraGateway
methods.description: Validates if the provided JSON object represents a valid LoRa gateway configuration.

methods.name: getNormalizedProviderUrlFromGatewayDevice
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the LoRa provider server URL from a gateway device JSON object.

methods.name: convertFromHexToBase64
methods.description: Converts a hex-encoded string to its Base64 representation.

methods.name: convertFromBase64ToHex
methods.description: Converts a Base64-encoded string to its hex representation.

methods.name: convertToHexString
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a hex string.

methods.name: getLoraConfigFromLoraGatewayDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the Lora configuration section from a gateway device JSON object.

methods.name: isHttpSuccessStatusCode
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates success (2xx).

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Determines if a string is null, empty, or only whitespace.
